Questa mattina ha reso le Comunicazioni al Senato della Repubblica ed a seguire l'intervento di replica.

Governo.titolo: Convocazione del Consiglio dei Ministri n. 192
Governo.descrizione: Il Consiglio dei ministri è convocato oggi, martedì 13 ottobre 2026, alle ore 19:00 a Palazzo Chigi, per l’esame del seguente ordine del giorno:

Si è svolta a Palazzo Chigi la riunione del Consiglio dei Ministri. I Ministri Musumeci (Protezione civile e politiche del mare) e Calderone (Lavoro e politiche sociali), hanno presentato in conferenza stampa i provvedimenti approvati.

Governo.titolo: Il Presidente Meloni all'Assemblea Generale di Assolombarda
Governo.descrizione: Il Presidente del Consiglio, Giorgia Meloni, ha partecipato all’Assemblea Generale di Assolombarda presso il Teatro Dal Verme, a Milano.

Governo.titolo: Il Presidente Meloni esprime la sua vicinanza al Santo Padre
Governo.descrizione: Desidero rivolgere al Santo Padre la mia vicinanza personale e quella del Governo italiano per la prova che è chiamato ad affrontare nei prossimi giorni. La serenità e la tranquillità con cui ne ha parlato nell'Angelus di oggi ci rincuorano. Sono certa che anche il popolo italiano non farà mancare il proprio sostegno e il proprio affetto.

Governo.titolo: Dichiarazione del Presidente del Consiglio, Giorgia Meloni
Governo.descrizione: Condanno con fermezza gli attacchi degli Houthi che hanno colpito l’aeroporto di Riad. Sono vicina all’Arabia Saudita e alle famiglie delle vittime e auguro ai feriti pronta guarigione. Gli attacchi contro i civili e le infrastrutture civili sono inaccettabili e devono cessare. L’Italia continuerà a lavorare con i partner della Regione per ridurre le tensioni e promuovere la stabilità e la libertà

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Team Europe strengthens support for Thailand’s climate resilience and water management
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The European Union has announced new financial support for the improvement of the irrigation system in the Lower East Chao Phraya river basin, including a €12 million grant to be blended with a loan from the French Development Agency (AFD) and co-financed with the Asian Development Bank.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Commission accepts commitments by Sanofi to address possible anticompetitive disparagement of competing flu vaccine for vulnerable patients
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The European Commission has made commitments offered by Sanofi legally binding under EU antitrust rules. The commitments relate to the Commission's preliminary competition concerns relating to Sanofi's alleged disparagement campaigns in Germany and France against Fluad...

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Screening of foreign direct investment continues to advance EU security and public order
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The European Commission closely cooperates with EU governments on screening investments from third countries to assess potential threats to European security or public order, shows a report published today.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: EU Water Resilience Investment Accelerator: Supporting financing for water-related projects
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The newly announced initiative will bring together investors and solution providers to support financing for water-related projects.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: 12.3 kg of e-waste collected per person in the EU
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: This compares with 32.4 kg of new electrical and electronic equipment per person put on the EU market during the same year.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: EU local leaders and authorities gather to discuss affordable energy, housing and climate resilience
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Tomorrow, hundreds of mayors, local and regional leaders and representatives from across Europe will come together in Brussels to participate in the EU Covenant of Mayors Ceremony 2026.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Making social protection information in Europe easier to compare and understand
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: New comparative tables and a set of infographics by Mutual Information System on Social Protection (MISSOC) offer a more accessible and user-friendly way to explore social protection systems across Europe.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Commission proposes flexibility to methane importers to help save costs
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The Commission proposes a one-year flexibility for importers on the methane regulation's monitoring and verification requirements, delaying the 2027 obligations to help save costs amid the energy crisis.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Growing use of AI in European companies
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: According to a new Eurobarometer survey, 63% of European small and medium sized enterprises (SMEs) and mid-cap companies already use (42%) artificial intelligence (AI) and algorithmic management (AM) or plan to do so in the coming years (21%).

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Commission allocates €168.2 million to boost Europe's defence production under the European Defence Industry Programme
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The European Commission has allocated €168.2 million to support the first eight projects under the Industrial Reinforcement Action (IRA) pillar of the European Defence Industry Programme (EDIP).

Commissione, notizie.titolo: EU signs Protocol to strengthen asset recovery and anti-money laundering cooperation
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: On 14 October, the EU signed the Additional Protocol to the Council of Europe Convention on Laundering, Search, Seizure and Confiscation of the Proceeds from Crime and on the Financing of Terrorism. With strengthened rules, it will also facilitate cooperation and prevention.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Cross-border gas network code – Commission launches call for feedback on revision of rules
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The European Commission has published a draft implementing regulation on the rules governing how cross-border gas transmission capacity is allocated and launched a 4-week call for feedback on the document.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: International Plain Language Day: making Commission texts clearer
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Find out more about clear language at the European Commission!

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Enlargement: Albania and EU provisionally close negotiations on enterprise and industrial policy
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Today, the EU and Albania provisionally closed accession negotiations on rules regarding enterprise and industrial policy.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: EU and Moldova start negotiations on internal market, competitiveness and inclusive growth
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Today, the EU and Moldova took another important step in the accession process by opening negotiations on the so-called ‘internal market’ and ‘competitiveness and inclusive growth’ clusters.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: EU opens accession negotiations with Ukraine on internal market, competitiveness and inclusive growth
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Today, the EU and Ukraine took another important step in the accession process by opening negotiations on the so-called ‘internal market’ and ‘competitiveness and inclusive growth’ clusters.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Commission approves Kimberly-Clark's acquisition of Kenvue, subject to conditions
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The European Commission has approved, under the EU Merger Regulation, the proposed acquisition by Kimberly-Clark Corporation ('Kimberly-Clark') of Kenvue Inc ('Kenvue'). The approval is conditional upon full compliance with the commitments offered by Kimberly-Clark.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Commission provides additional EU funding to strengthen border security
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The European Commission is providing an additional EUR 130 million under the Border Management and Visa Instrument to support drone and counter-drone measures that strengthen security at the EU external borders.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: EU and enlargement partners join forces to strengthen democratic resilience across Europe
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Today, on the occasion of the General Affairs Council in Luxembourg, candidate countries and potential candidates were associated with the European Centre for Democratic Resilience. Bringing together ministers from all 27 EU Member States and colleagues from Albania, Bosnia and Herzegovina...

Commissione, notizie.titolo: EU tests reveal compliance issues in safety footwear
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: An EU-funded product testing campaign examined 83 models of safety shoes and found that most (82%) did not meet EU safety and formal requirements.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Job quality is a priority in the EU, according to annual Commission report
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: According to the 2026 European Employment and Social Outlook, the quality of jobs in the EU has improved over the past decade. The report points to progress in three areas: pay, job security, and working time.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Cities Helpdesk: the new entry point to EU support for cities
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The new Cities Helpdesk is being launched to help cities across Europe access the EU knowledge, funding and connections they need to tackle urban challenges.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: The 17th EU-China Joint Steering Committee meeting on Science and Technology Cooperation
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: DG RTD and China’s Ministry of Science and Technology (MOST) met in Beijing to discuss STI policies, review progress on joint research flagship initiatives, and exchange views on wider R&I cooperation.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: The European Centre for Democratic Resilience opens cooperation to candidate countries and potential candidates
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The European Centre for Democratic Resilience opens cooperation to candidate countries and potential candidates

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Strengthening Uptake and Exploitation of Horizon Europe “Civil Security” Research and Innovation: Tips for Proposers
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: This document provides practical guidance to help Horizon Europe Cluster-3 applicants strengthen the exploitation and uptake of project results from the earliest stages of project design through implementation and beyond the end of the project.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: The Commission launches a repository for transparency information on online political ads
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Commission launches pilot European Repository for online political ads, boosting transparency and accountability. The platform helps publishers meet rules and enables researchers, journalists and citizens to scrutinise sponsors, funding and targeting.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Commission opens in-depth investigation into XXXLutz's proposed acquisition of Porta
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The European Commission has opened an in-depth investigation to assess XXXLutz's proposed acquisition of Porta, under the EU Merger Regulation.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Enlargement: EU and Montenegro close accession negotiations in the areas of economic and monetary policy, statistics, and social policy and employment
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Today, the EU and Montenegro provisionally closed accession negotiations on economic and monetary policy (chapter 17), statistics (chapter 18) and social policy and employment (chapter 19).

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Multilateralism: Council sets EU position ahead of climate change and biodiversity summits
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Today, the Council approved two sets of conclusions setting out the EU’s main negotiating positions ahead of the United Nations climate change (COP31) and biodiversity (COP17) summits.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: EU adopts largest-ever package of listings against Russia
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The package targets almost 1600 individuals and entities in Russia’s military‑industrial complex.
